title: AgentOdyssey：用于测试时持续学习智能体的开放式长程文本游戏生成
summary: AgentOdyssey 是一个评估框架，通过程序化生成开放式文本游戏，测试智能体在部署期间的持续学习能力，包括探索、知识获取、记忆和长程规划。实验表明，即使是最强的智能体也远低于人类水平，短期记忆是关键组件。
summary_en: AgentOdyssey is an evaluation framework that procedurally generates open-ended text games to test agents' continual learning abilities during deployment, including exploration, knowledge acquisition, memory, and long-horizon planning. Experiments show even top agents far below human performance, with short-term memory being a key component.
